en.title: The removal of Arius and the Arian heresy

After the Council of Chalcedon, for 150 years, the successive Emperors of Constantinople tried hard to unite the Church. The Emperor Zeno, who reigned from 474-491, and Emperor Anastasius, who reigned from 491-518, wanted the Tewahedo faith, which teaches 'one nature,' to be accepted, but the Council of Chalcedon and the Letter of Leo stood as obstacles.
